Imagine paying extra rent... because you work from home.

That's exactly what one Bay Area rental listing tried to do by charging tenants an additional $200 per month just for working remotely.

Is it really about utilities... or are landlords just inventing new fees because they can?

In this video, we break down the viral rental listing, the ridiculous "work from home fee," and why it feels like every inconvenience in modern life is slowly turning into another monthly subscription.
